identify: The full-grown larva is dark or dark brown. It has a plump and greasy body.
The larva has striped markings along the sides of its body and lives in the soil.

cultural: Place heaps of rice bran in several places in the late afternoon. Remove the larvae from the bran next day and destroy them.
Flood the field before planting when you can.
